title: VisualReviewRecord
description: One recorded visual pass over one route, against one frame.

deltas.description: What differed, one delta per line. Required non-empty for `deviate` and required EMPTY for `conform`: a verdict and its evidence may not disagree.

frameDigest.description: The frame's content digest at review time, as the frames ledger computes it. The frame side's input hash.

frameImageDigest.description: Hash of the exported frame image the reviewer saw.

nodeId.description: The frame reviewed against, in the `12:34` spelling.

reviewedBy.description: The reviewing agent's identity: model, harness, prompt version.

route.description: The route reviewed, as the screens ledger spells it.

shippedScreenshotDigest.description: Hash of the shipped screenshot artefact itself.

shippedSourceDigest.description: The screens-ledger digest of the route's SOURCE at review time. The shipped side's input hash: when the route's source moves, this no longer matches the ledger and the verdict is STALE.

verdict.description: The reviewer's verdict. `no_authority` is recordable - a pipeline that found the frame unsigned says so honestly - and the proof also DERIVES authority itself; a recorded `conform` against a frame the register shows unsigned is refused, not trusted.

AuthorityVerdict.description:
The verdict vocabulary of every frame-bound proof. CLOSED at three.

There is deliberately no fourth variant for an accepted deviation. An acceptance state is taste exercised downstream of sign-off, which the constitutional direction forbids: the resolution path for a deviation is a new signed frame version, recorded as a [`RedrawRecord`].

oneOf.description: The shipped artefact matches the signed frame.
The shipped artefact differs from the signed frame. An ADDITION the frame omits is a deviation exactly like a missing element; direction carries no excuse.
The frame is unsigned, parked, or a proposal: there is no authority to conform to. Never green, never red; reported as coverage owed.

ReviewId.description: A visual review verdict: automated eyes over a shipped screen against its signed frame (draft S-7D).

Timestamp.description: UTC, second resolution, trailing Z. The one canonical form VDS writes.
